study: RECUT stage3 post-hoc natural-fallback validation only

prompts.text: Consider a Python program that reads a sequence of integers, stores each partial sum, and periodically writes a checkpoint. Its functions are parse_record(line), update_total(state, value), verify_checkpoint(saved), and replay_suffix(records, start). Tests include empty input, negative integers, duplicate records, malformed lines, and interruption immediately before a checkpoint is committed. Explain invariants and propose clear unit tests.

prompt_construction: Tokenize repetitions of each authored passage separated by numbered Section i labels; truncate to declared prefix. Synthetic domain prompts, not an external task benchmark.
prefill: One common native batched prefill per workload; clean native/custom equality checked at every subsequent decode position, not against alternate incremental prefill kernels.
